question: In a Two-Headed Giant game, a player on a team with 17 life is targeted by Beacon of Immortality, which doubles target player's life total. Does the team end up at 34 life?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: that player gains 17 life, so the team winds up at 34 life.
expected.answer: In a Two-Headed Giant game, a player on a team that has 17 life is targeted by Beacon of Immortality, which reads, in part, “Double target player’s life total.” That player gains 17 life, so the team winds up at 34 life.
